sentences.en: The flasher was arrested for indecent exposure and sexual harassment.
sentences.zh: 闪光灯被逮捕了，因为不雅暴露和性骚扰。

sentences.en: People who develop freckles should avoid direct exposure to sunlight.
sentences.zh: 容易长雀斑的人应该避免直接日晒。

sentences.en: Can passive exposure to Berber help me learn this language?
sentences.zh: 我可以通过被动接触柏柏语来学习这种语言吗？
